h1: The 4 Best Bissell Cordless Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Bissell Cordless Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: four Bissell PowerClean cordless vacuums, from the 200W base model to the 280W DualBrush, with runtimes and what separates them.
summary: The Bissell PowerClean FurGuard 280W is the best all-round pick with a 50 minute runtime. The DualBrush 280W matches that runtime, the FurFinder 200W adds a pet focus at 40 minutes, and the base PowerClean 200W is the cheapest way into the line.
intro: Four Bissell PowerClean models look almost identical, which is where buyers go wrong. The real difference is wattage and runtime, and the names mostly signal pet or brush features.
We reviewed four self-standing Bissell cordless vacuums and ranked them on the listed specifications: wattage, runtime and price tier. Where a listing gives no figure, we leave it out.

products.name: Bissell PowerClean FurGuard 280W Self-Standing Cordless Vacuum
products.verdict: 280W and a 50 minute runtime in a self-standing cordless body.
products.description:
The FurGuard is a 280W self-standing cordless vacuum with a listed 50 minute runtime.

It ranks first because it combines the higher 280W rating with the long runtime and a cordless build, 10 minutes more than the 200W models. The tradeoff against the DualBrush is the pet-oriented FurGuard name.

Choose it for homes with pets. The caveat is the $200 to $500 tier.

products.name: Bissell PowerClean DualBrush 280W Self-Standing Vacuum
products.verdict: The same 280W and 50 minutes with a DualBrush design.
products.description:
The DualBrush is a 280W self-standing vacuum with a listed 50 minute runtime.

It ranks second because it matches the FurGuard on wattage and runtime, but the listing does not state cordless, which the FurGuard does.

It suits buyers who want the DualBrush. The caveat is that cordless is not confirmed.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the DualBrush model.

products.name: Bissell PowerClean FurFinder 200W Self-Standing Cordless Vacuum
products.verdict: A 200W FurFinder with a 40 minute runtime.
products.description:
The FurFinder is a 200W self-standing cordless vacuum with a listed 40 minute runtime.

It ranks third because it has 80W less power than the 280W models and 10 fewer minutes, though it costs the same tier of $200 to $500.

It suits pet owners who accept lower power. The caveat is that it costs as much as the 280W models.
products.skipIf: You want more power for the money.

products.name: Bissell PowerClean 200W Self-Standing Cordless Vacuum
products.verdict: The base 200W PowerClean with 40 minutes of runtime.
products.description:
The base PowerClean is a 200W self-standing cordless vacuum with a listed 40 minute runtime, in the $100 to $200 tier.

Last place goes to the lowest power rating, but it is the cheapest of the four and matches the FurFinder on runtime.

It suits small homes. The caveat is the 200W rating.

whatMatters.detail: Watts are a rough sign of motor power, and these models list 200W or 280W. Higher is not a promise of better cleaning, so check the listing figure.
Runtime is how long one charge lasts, from 40 to 50 minutes here. Enough runtime avoids stopping mid-clean. Find the minutes in the title or bullets.
A self-standing vacuum stays upright without leaning. It matters for quick pauses. Check for self-standing in the title.
Cordless frees you from a cable but needs charging. Confirm cordless is listed.
FurFinder and FurGuard names point to pet hair handling, but the listing figures matter. Check the bullets.

finalTake: The Bissell PowerClean FurGuard 280W is the best of the four thanks to higher power and 50 minutes of runtime. The DualBrush is a close second, and the base PowerClean 200W is the budget route.
